domains.title: Rongo
domains.subtitle: Agriculture
domains.lead: Rongo is agriculture, peace, cultivated foods. The name means "Peace, news (from Proto-Polynesian *longo)" and belongs to the polynesian tradition.

mythology.lead: The stories of Rongo place agriculture, peace, cultivated foods at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Rongo appears in polynesian tradition as agriculture, peace, cultivated foods. The name's meaning, "Peace, news (from Proto-Polynesian *longo)", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Rongo in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Rongo remains a touchstone for understanding polynesian religion, art, and identity.
